##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 5 on_actions, generated by tools/gen_script_gsu.py
# Hooked into random_yearly_playable_pulse and the war-result lists in eir_on_actions.txt
##########################################################################

# A 10% chance a year once the realm holds more than 75% of England (first time, and again 50 years after the first).
eir_gsu_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		eir_gsu_ready_trigger = yes
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 10
		1 = eir.0900
	}
}

# The rebels won (they were the attackers).
eir_war_won_attacker_gsu = {
	effect = {
		scope:attacker = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eir_gsu_player }
				save_scope_as = eir_up_leader
				var:eir_gsu_duchy ?= { save_scope_as = eir_up_duchy }
				var:eir_gsu_player ?= { save_scope_as = eir_gsu_player }
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:eir_gsu_player }
					scope:eir_gsu_player = {
						eir_gsu_rebel_won_effect = yes
						trigger_event = eir.0905
						eir_gsu_check_end_effect = yes
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eir_gsu_player
				remove_variable = eir_gsu_duchy
			}
		}
	}
}

# The rebels lost (the defender won).
eir_war_won_defender_gsu = {
	effect = {
		scope:attacker = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eir_gsu_player }
				save_scope_as = eir_up_leader
				var:eir_gsu_duchy ?= { save_scope_as = eir_up_duchy }
				var:eir_gsu_player ?= { save_scope_as = eir_gsu_player }
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:eir_gsu_player }
					scope:eir_gsu_player = {
						eir_gsu_rebel_lost_effect = yes
						trigger_event = eir.0904
						eir_gsu_check_end_effect = yes
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eir_gsu_player
				remove_variable = eir_gsu_duchy
			}
		}
	}
}
